messages:
maria-partnerships: Quick check-in on marketplace go-live choreography. Need to lock press embargo, partner pre-brief cadence, landing assets, SI handoff, and legal signoff. Who's owning what?
aj-marketing: Ill take press + blog drafts. Will need hero art and one alt CTA. Prefer embargo Wed 10am PT.
kevin-product: Landing prototype ready. Will add SKU table for hardware partners if design supplies spec. Also will add sample manifest examples for ENG.
sienna-legal: Send the embargoed press memo + any partner quotes. I can review within 24h unless external NDAs complicate.
oliver-eng: We need partner manifests in staging bucket to validate. Please follow schema v2.1. Ill run the validation once uploaded.
lena-sis: SI onboarding kit at 70%. Need dev product IDs and runbook snippet for partner SIs. ETA Thu morning.
devon-ops: Proposed staging freeze Thu 23:00 PT, deploy Fri 01:00 PT, public announce Wed 10:00 PT. If a partner requests earlier, we can do a gated pre-brief under NDA.
deploy-bot: [automated] Current checklist: press memo 10% | blog 0% | landing 85% | SI kit 70% | legal queued. Use /launch-status to update.
maria-partnerships: Note: EdgeCloud wants Fri embargo to align with distributor channels. We can support a staggered announce; marketing/legal to confirm language variants.
aj-marketing: Ill prepare a short embargoed deck for EdgeCloud and a general press memo. Links: https://short.url/market-press-draft
kevin-product: Added manifest examples and sample product IDs to landing doc. @oliver-eng please validate.
oliver-eng: Will run parser tonight against staging manifests. Send to infra-staging.
sienna-legal: NDA required for partner pre-briefs. Provide list of external contacts and exact deck.
lena-sis: SI kit updated with redacted API keys and onboarding checklist: https://short.url/si-kit-v2
devon-ops: Ops bridge scheduled for deploy window; rollback plan in place.
maria-partnerships: Action owners recap: @aj-marketing press/blog, @kevin-product landing/manifests, @lena-sis SI kit, @sienna-legal legal, @devon-ops deploy. Dry run Fri 09:00 PT. Flag blockers ASAP. :rocket:
